limitations: Artiverse is a human-verified pre-release dataset reference, not a generated prediction method.
Annotation-to-URDF agreement is export fidelity, not independent semantic accuracy.
Complex joints can be split or downgraded in standard URDF; logical annotation joints and simulator DoFs are reported separately.
The release card has license=other and requires acceptance of upstream-source licenses.

release.access: manual gated; locally materialized by authorized user
release.snapshot_state: pre-release subset; README says cleanup is ongoing

scope.functional_selection: one asset per category by argmin SHA256(salt|asset_id), frozen from the complete manifest before and without filtering on static validity or PyBullet outcomes
scope.selection: all roots listed in the selected manifest chunk; no outcome filtering

semantic_metric_boundary.axis_valid: N/A semantic; annotation and URDF metadata coverage are reported separately
semantic_metric_boundary.joint_recall: N/A for Artiverse itself: annotation and URDF share a release pipeline
semantic_metric_boundary.joint_type_accuracy: N/A for Artiverse itself: dataset reference, not a prediction
semantic_metric_boundary.limit_valid: N/A semantic; annotation and URDF metadata coverage are reported separately
semantic_metric_boundary.origin_valid: N/A semantic; annotation and URDF metadata coverage are reported separately
semantic_metric_boundary.parent_child_accuracy: N/A for Artiverse itself: structural validity is reported separately
